_readme: Copy this file to app-registrations.json and fill in your Entra ID app registration values. app-registrations.json is gitignored. See Process.md for setup instructions.

bc-custom-api.description: Entra ID app registration for 4PS custom BC API access
bc-custom-api._client_id_hint: Azure Portal > App registrations > your app > Application (client) ID
bc-custom-api._client_secret_hint: Azure Portal > App registrations > your app > Certificates & secrets > client secret Value
bc-custom-api._tenant_id_hint: Azure Portal > App registrations > your app > Directory (tenant) ID
bc-custom-api._environment_name_hint: The BC environment name as it appears in the URL, e.g. 'Production' or 'latestrelease'
bc-custom-api._company_id_hint: BC company GUID - find it via GET .../companies or from the BC Admin Center
